ir.name: builder_gap_topk_pairs_003
ir.intuition: Select preference pairs only when the objective gap is meaningfully positive (to reduce noisy ties/near-ties), then cap pairs per instance and globally using deterministic top-k by gap magnitude.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # lower objective is better; prefer i over j when objective[i] + gap_thr < objective[j]
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 1e-3))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))

    # pairwise gap matrix: gap[b,i,j] = objective[b,j] - objective[b,i]
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]
    valid = gap > gap_thr

    # Select strongest gaps first (deterministic) and cap per instance.
    B, T = objective.shape
    flat_gap = gap.view(B, -1)
    flat_valid = valid.view(B, -1)
    # Exclude invalid and diagonal by setting to -inf
    scores = torch.where(flat_valid, flat_gap, torch.full_like(flat_gap, float('-inf')))
    k_per = min(max_pairs_per_instance, T * T)
    top_scores, top_idx = torch.topk(scores, k=k_per, dim=1)
    keep = top_scores > float('-inf')

    # Decode (i,j) from flattened index
    winner_idx = (top_idx // T).masked_select(keep)
    loser_idx = (top_idx % T).masked_select(keep)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_per).masked_select(keep)

    # Global cap by strongest gaps
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        sel_scores = top_scores.masked_select(keep)
        _, order = torch.topk(sel_scores, k=max_pairs, dim=0)
        b_idx = b_idx[order]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[order]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[order]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'gap_topk_pairs',
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance,
        },
    )

ir.name: builder_anchor_gap_topk
ir.intuition: Build stable preferences by anchoring each instance’s best (lowest objective) sample against a small set of clearly worse samples, filtered by an objective-gap threshold and capped via top-k worst losers to respect per-instance pair budgets.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # objective: [B, N], lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Choose a single winner anchor per instance: argmin objective
    winner = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # [B]
    b = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)
    winner_obj = objective[b, winner]  # [B]

    # Candidate losers must be worse than the winner by at least a gap threshold
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    diffs = objective - winner_obj[:, None]  # [B, N]
    valid = diffs > gap_thr

    # Never pair winner with itself
    valid.scatter_(1, winner[:, None], False)

    # Cap pairs per instance
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 16))
    k = int(min(max_pairs_per_instance, max(0, N - 1)))

    # Pick the k worst (largest objective) valid losers; invalid get -inf so they sink
    score = objective.masked_fill(~valid, float('-inf'))
    topv, topi = score.topk(k=k, dim=1)
    sel = topv.isfinite()  # [B, k]

    b_idx = b[:, None].expand(B, k)[sel]
    loser_idx = topi[sel]
    winner_idx = winner[:, None].expand(B, k)[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_gap_topk', 'gap_threshold': gap_thr, 'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance})

ir.name: builder_sampled_gap_weight_001
ir.intuition: Sampled pairwise preferences can be noisy when objective differences are tiny; adding a nonnegative weight proportional to the objective gap emphasizes clearer winner/loser separations while keeping broad coverage.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 452))
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        perm = torch.randperm(b_idx.numel(), device=b_idx.device)[:max_pairs]
        b_idx = b_idx[perm]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[perm]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[perm]
    gap = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp_min(0)
    gap_scale = float(extra.get('gap_scale', 1.0))
    weight = gap / (gap + gap_scale)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'sampled_gap_weight', 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'gap_scale': gap_scale})

ir.name: builder_gap_threshold_strict64
ir.intuition: Construct only high-confidence winner/loser pairs where the lower objective beats the higher objective by at least a margin, exclude self-pairs, and enforce a strict per-instance cap of 64 by taking the largest objective-gap pairs so the preference set stays reliable and within budget.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, N]

    # Lower objective is better; keep only pairs with sufficient improvement margin.
    gap_threshold = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    if max_pairs > 64:
        max_pairs = 64

    B, N = objective.shape

    # gap[b,i,j] = objective[b,i] - objective[b,j]
    gap = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]  # [B, N, N]
    margin = (-gap).clamp_min(0.0)  # positive when i better than j

    # i beats j by at least threshold; exclude diagonal.
    win_mask = margin > gap_threshold
    if N > 0:
        diag = torch.eye(N, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.bool)[None, :, :]
        win_mask = win_mask & (~diag)

    # Score only valid wins; invalid entries become -inf so they won't be selected.
    neg_inf = margin.new_full(margin.shape, float('-inf'))
    scored = torch.where(win_mask, margin, neg_inf)  # [B, N, N]

    scored_flat = scored.reshape(B, N * N)  # [B, N*N]

    # Choose up to 64 strongest pairs per instance.
    k = max_pairs
    if k < 1:
        k = 1
    if k > (N * N):
        k = N * N

    top_vals, top_idx = scored_flat.topk(k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)  # [B, k]
    keep = top_vals.isfinite()  # [B, k]

    # Build indices for kept entries; this yields <= max_pairs per instance by construction.
    pos = keep.nonzero(as_tuple=False)  # [M, 2] with columns (b, t)
    b_idx = pos[:, 0].to(dtype=torch.long)
    t_idx = pos[:, 1].to(dtype=torch.long)

    flat = top_idx[b_idx, t_idx].to(dtype=torch.long)  # [M]
    winner_idx = (flat // N).to(dtype=torch.long)
    loser_idx = (flat % N).to(dtype=torch.long)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'gap_threshold_strict64',
            'gap_threshold': float(gap_threshold),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs),
        },
    )

ir.name: builder_stratified_rank_pairs_v1
ir.intuition: Builds per-instance preferences by ranking candidates by objective (lower is better) and pairing top/mid/tail strata: near-best vs near-worst plus a few adjacent-rank pairs to provide both strong and fine-grained learning signals, while capping pairs per instance and guaranteeing full coverage.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # Rank-based, stratified pairing with per-instance cap and full coverage.
    # objective shape: [B, K] where lower is better.
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Per-instance pair cap (must also satisfy global max_pairs_per_instance gate).
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    if max_pairs_per_instance < 1:
        max_pairs_per_instance = 1

    # Choose how many "anchors" from each stratum.
    # a: number of top and tail anchors; m: number of mid anchors.
    a = int(extra.get('num_anchors', 4))
    m = int(extra.get('num_mid', 4))
    if a < 1:
        a = 1
    if m < 0:
        m = 0

    # Sort indices by objective ascending (best first).
    sorted_idx = objective.argsort(dim=1, stable=True)  # [B, K]

    # Helper sizes.
    a_eff = a if a < K else K
    tail_eff = a_eff

    top = sorted_idx[:, :a_eff]  # [B, a]
    tail = sorted_idx[:, K - tail_eff:]  # [B, a]

    # Mid stratum centered around median.
    if m > 0 and K > 2:
        mid_start = (K // 2) - (m // 2)
        if mid_start < 0:
            mid_start = 0
        if mid_start + m > K:
            mid_start = K - m
        if mid_start < 0:
            mid_start = 0
        mid_eff = m if m < K else K
        mid = sorted_idx[:, mid_start:mid_start + mid_eff]  # [B, m]
    else:
        mid_eff = 0
        mid = sorted_idx[:, :0]

    # Construct pairs (winner has lower objective):
    # 1) top vs tail (strong signal)
    # 2) top vs mid (medium signal)
    # 3) mid vs tail (medium signal)
    # 4) adjacent rank pairs across the full list (fine-grained)

    # (1) top vs tail: [B, a, a] -> flatten
    w1 = top[:, :, None].expand(B, a_eff, tail_eff)
    l1 = tail[:, None, :].expand(B, a_eff, tail_eff)
    w1 = w1.reshape(B, -1)
    l1 = l1.reshape(B, -1)

    # (2) top vs mid
    if mid_eff > 0:
        w2 = top[:, :, None].expand(B, a_eff, mid_eff).reshape(B, -1)
        l2 = mid[:, None, :].expand(B, a_eff, mid_eff).reshape(B, -1)
    else:
        w2 = w1[:, :0]
        l2 = l1[:, :0]

    # (3) mid vs tail
    if mid_eff > 0:
        w3 = mid[:, :, None].expand(B, mid_eff, tail_eff).reshape(B, -1)
        l3 = tail[:, None, :].expand(B, mid_eff, tail_eff).reshape(B, -1)
    else:
        w3 = w1[:, :0]
        l3 = l1[:, :0]

    # (4) adjacent pairs (i better than i+1): [B, K-1]
    if K > 1:
        w4 = sorted_idx[:, :-1]
        l4 = sorted_idx[:, 1:]
    else:
        w4 = w1[:, :0]
        l4 = l1[:, :0]

    # Concatenate candidate pair lists per instance.
    w_all = torch.cat([w4, w1, w2, w3], dim=1)
    l_all = torch.cat([l4, l1, l2, l3], dim=1)

    # Remove self-pairs (shouldn't happen) and optionally drop ties by objective.
    # Ties: only keep if strictly better per objective.
    if K > 0:
        ow = objective.gather(1, w_all)
        ol = objective.gather(1, l_all)
        valid = (w_all != l_all) & (ow < ol)
    else:
        valid = (w_all != l_all)

    # Ensure at least one pair per instance: keep the best adjacent pair (rank 0 vs 1) if needed.
    if K > 1:
        fallback_w = sorted_idx[:, :1]
        fallback_l = sorted_idx[:, 1:2]
    else:
        fallback_w = sorted_idx[:, :0]
        fallback_l = sorted_idx[:, :0]

    # Select up to max_pairs_per_instance per instance without Python loops.
    # We prioritize earlier blocks by keeping original order and taking first N valid.
    # Use a running count via cumsum to do per-row top-N.
    valid_int = valid.to(torch.int64)
    rank = valid_int.cumsum(dim=1)
    take = valid & (rank <= max_pairs_per_instance)

    # If an instance has zero taken pairs, force-add fallback (if available).
    taken_counts = take.to(torch.int64).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # [B, 1]
    need_fallback = (taken_counts == 0)

    # Flatten taken pairs.
    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand_as(w_all)
    b_idx = b_grid[take]
    winner_idx = w_all[take]
    loser_idx = l_all[take]

    if K > 1:
        # Append fallback pairs where needed.
        b_fb = torch.arange(B, device=device)[need_fallback.squeeze(1)]
        w_fb = fallback_w[need_fallback.squeeze(1)].reshape(-1)
        l_fb = fallback_l[need_fallback.squeeze(1)].reshape(-1)
        if b_fb.numel() > 0:
            b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_fb], dim=0)
            winner_idx = torch.cat([winner_idx, w_fb], dim=0)
            loser_idx = torch.cat([loser_idx, l_fb], dim=0)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'stratified_rank_pairs',
            'num_anchors': a,
            'num_mid': m,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance
        }
    )

ir.name: builder_anchor_gap_topk_000
ir.intuition: Build stable preferences by anchoring each instance’s best objective candidate against its worst and a few hardest negatives (closest-but-worse), while filtering tiny objective gaps to reduce label noise and capping per-instance pairs via topk.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # objective: [B, N], lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    gap_threshold = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    k_hard = int(extra.get('k_hard', 3))
    k_hard = max(0, min(k_hard, max(0, N - 1)))

    # Winners are per-instance best (min) objective.
    winner_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # [B]
    win_obj = objective.gather(1, winner_idx[:, None])  # [B, 1]

    # Candidate losers: strictly worse than winner by at least threshold.
    gap = objective - win_obj  # [B, N]
    valid = gap > gap_threshold
    # Never pair item with itself.
    valid = valid & (torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)[None, :] != winner_idx[:, None])

    # Hard negatives: among valid losers, choose smallest positive gaps (closest-but-worse).
    # Mask invalid with +inf so they won't be selected by topk(largest=False).
    inf = torch.tensor(float('inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = torch.where(valid, gap, inf)  # [B, N]

    pairs_b = []
    pairs_w = []
    pairs_l = []

    if k_hard > 0:
        hard_vals, hard_idx = torch.topk(score, k=k_hard, dim=1, largest=False)
        hard_ok = torch.isfinite(hard_vals)  # [B, k]
        if hard_ok.any():
            b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_hard)[hard_ok]
            l_idx = hard_idx[hard_ok]
            w_idx = winner_idx[b_idx]
            pairs_b.append(b_idx)
            pairs_w.append(w_idx)
            pairs_l.append(l_idx)

    # Extreme negative: worst objective that is also valid; always at most one per instance.
    # Mask invalid with -inf to pick the worst among valid.
    ninf = torch.tensor(float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    worst_score = torch.where(valid, objective, ninf)
    worst_idx = worst_score.argmax(dim=1)  # [B]
    worst_ok = valid.gather(1, worst_idx[:, None]).squeeze(1)
    if worst_ok.any():
        b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[worst_ok]
        w_idx = winner_idx[b_idx]
        l_idx = worst_idx[worst_ok]
        pairs_b.append(b_idx)
        pairs_w.append(w_idx)
        pairs_l.append(l_idx)

    if len(pairs_b) == 0:
        # Fallback: if threshold filtered everything, just do best-vs-worst per instance.
        worst_idx = objective.argmax(dim=1)
        b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)
        w_idx = winner_idx
        l_idx = worst_idx
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_gap_topk', 'gap_threshold': gap_threshold, 'k_hard': k_hard, 'fallback': True})

    b_idx = torch.cat(pairs_b, dim=0)
    w_idx = torch.cat(pairs_w, dim=0)
    l_idx = torch.cat(pairs_l, dim=0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_gap_topk', 'gap_threshold': gap_threshold, 'k_hard': k_hard})

ir.name: builder_rank_stratified_cap_005
ir.intuition: All parents rely on objective-only, deterministic pair construction (sometimes with a gap threshold) but either explode to all pairs or use random subsampling that can hurt coverage and violate per-instance caps. This builder keeps the strength of objective-consistent winners while changing the mechanism to rank-based, stratified pairing (best-vs-tail, best-vs-mid, mid-vs-tail) with a fixed per-instance cap that guarantees full instance coverage without randomness.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # lower objective is better
    B, K = objective.shape

    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    # use up to 3 strata; ensure at least 1 pair per instance
    strata = int(extra.get('strata', 3))
    strata = 1 if strata < 1 else (3 if strata > 3 else strata)
    pairs_per_instance = max_pairs_per_instance
    if pairs_per_instance < 1:
        pairs_per_instance = 1

    # Rank each instance's candidates (ascending objective)
    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # [B, K]

    # Choose deterministic anchor indices from ranks
    best = order[:, 0]  # [B]
    mid_rank = K // 2
    mid = order[:, mid_rank]
    tail = order[:, -1]

    # Allocate counts across strata, fill remainder into best-vs-tail (hardest contrast)
    # c1: best vs tail, c2: best vs mid, c3: mid vs tail
    if strata == 1:
        c1, c2, c3 = pairs_per_instance, 0, 0
    elif strata == 2:
        c1 = pairs_per_instance // 2
        c2 = pairs_per_instance - c1
        c3 = 0
    else:
        c1 = pairs_per_instance // 3
        c2 = pairs_per_instance // 3
        c3 = pairs_per_instance - c1 - c2

    # Build per-instance pair index matrices without Python loops over pair tensors
    def _repeat_pair(w, l, n):
        if n <= 0:
            return None
        w = w[:, None].expand(B, n)
        l = l[:, None].expand(B, n)
        return w, l

    p1 = _repeat_pair(best, tail, c1)
    p2 = _repeat_pair(best, mid, c2)
    p3 = _repeat_pair(mid, tail, c3)

    # Concatenate strata
    w_list = []
    l_list = []
    if p1 is not None:
        w_list.append(p1[0])
        l_list.append(p1[1])
    if p2 is not None:
        w_list.append(p2[0])
        l_list.append(p2[1])
    if p3 is not None:
        w_list.append(p3[0])
        l_list.append(p3[1])

    winner_mat = torch.cat(w_list, dim=1)  # [B, P]
    loser_mat = torch.cat(l_list, dim=1)   # [B, P]

    # Filter any accidental self-pairs (can happen when K==1)
    valid = winner_mat != loser_mat
    # Ensure at least one pair per instance if possible
    # If K==1, no valid pairs exist; return empty and let gate handle.
    if valid.any():
        b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand_as(winner_mat)
        b_idx = b_idx[valid]
        winner_idx = winner_mat[valid]
        loser_idx = loser_mat[valid]
    else:
        b_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        winner_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        loser_idx = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_stratified_cap',
            'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance,
            'strata': strata
        }
    )

ir.name: builder_anchor_gap_topk_001
ir.intuition: Form preferences by comparing each instance's best (lowest objective) candidate against a small set of the worst candidates, prioritizing larger objective gaps to avoid noisy near-ties while keeping pair count bounded and coverage guaranteed.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    B, K = objective.shape

    # Anchor each batch item at its best (lowest-objective) candidate.
    winner_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # [B]

    # Compute gap vs anchor (positive means candidate is worse than anchor).
    anchor_obj = objective.gather(1, winner_idx[:, None])  # [B, 1]
    gap = objective - anchor_obj  # [B, K]

    # Exclude self-pairs; optionally require a minimum gap to reduce near-ties.
    thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    gap = gap.masked_fill(torch.arange(K, device=objective.device)[None, :] == winner_idx[:, None], float('-inf'))
    valid = gap > thr

    # Select up to max_pairs_per_instance hardest negatives (largest gaps) per instance.
    mppi = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 4))
    mppi = max(1, min(mppi, K - 1))
    gap_for_topk = gap.masked_fill(~valid, float('-inf'))
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(gap_for_topk, k=mppi, dim=1)
    topk_valid = topk_vals.isfinite()

    # If threshold filters everything for an instance, fall back to worst candidates.
    worst_vals, worst_idx = torch.topk(gap, k=mppi, dim=1)
    need_fallback = ~topk_valid.any(dim=1)
    loser_idx_mat = torch.where(need_fallback[:, None], worst_idx, topk_idx)
    chosen_valid = torch.where(need_fallback[:, None], worst_vals.isfinite(), topk_valid)

    # Flatten selected pairs with a mask (vectorized).
    b_mat = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, mppi)
    w_mat = winner_idx[:, None].expand(B, mppi)

    b_idx = b_mat[chosen_valid]
    w_idx = w_mat[chosen_valid]
    l_idx = loser_idx_mat[chosen_valid]

    # Optional global cap to respect a total budget.
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        b_idx = b_idx[:max_pairs]
        w_idx = w_idx[:max_pairs]
        l_idx = l_idx[:max_pairs]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_gap_topk', 'gap_threshold': thr, 'max_pairs_per_instance': mppi, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

ir.name: builder_all_pairs_gapcap_003
ir.intuition: Generate deterministic pairwise preferences from strictly better (lower) objective values, optionally requiring a minimum objective gap and capping total pairs via top-k hardest gaps to stay within budget.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, K], lower is better
    B, K = objective.shape

    # Configurable thresholds/caps
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    # Pairwise objective gaps: gap[b, i, j] = obj[b, j] - obj[b, i]
    # i is winner if obj[b, i] < obj[b, j] and gap >= gap_thr
    obj_i = objective[:, :, None]
    obj_j = objective[:, None, :]
    gap = obj_j - obj_i

    # Only consider strict improvements (and optional margin)
    mask = gap > gap_thr

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache.get('log_prob', None)

    # objective: [B, K], lower is better
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs_per_instance = max(1, min(max_pairs_per_instance, K - 1))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))

    # Anchor winner per instance: best (lowest objective)
    w = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # [B]

    # Compute gap for anchor vs all candidates: gap = obj_loser - obj_winner
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, w[:, None])  # [B, 1]
    gap = objective - obj_w  # [B, K]

    # Valid losers: not the winner itself and must exceed min_gap
    ar = torch.arange(K, device=device)[None, :]
    valid = (ar != w[:, None]) & (gap > min_gap)

    # Score losers: larger gap is better; tie-break with higher log_prob if provided
    neg_inf = torch.tensor(-1.0e9, device=device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = gap
    if log_prob is not None:
        # small tie-breaker to prefer more likely losers among similar gaps
        score = score + (log_prob - log_prob.detach().mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)) * 1.0e-3

    score = torch.where(valid, score, neg_inf)

    # Select top-k losers per instance (vectorized)
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(score, k=max_pairs_per_instance, dim=1)
    chosen = topk_vals > (neg_inf * 0.5)

    # Flatten selected pairs
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, max_pairs_per_instance)[chosen]
    loser_idx = topk_idx[chosen]
    winner_idx = w[b_idx]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'anchor_gap_topk',
            'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance,
            'gap_threshold': min_gap
        }
    )

This builder keeps deterministic, objective-only signals but changes the mechanism to rank-quantile pairing: every instance contributes the same capped number of pairs by pairing several better-quantile anchors against worse-quantile targets, with a rank-gap threshold to suppress near-ties while guaranteeing coverage.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # lower objective is better
    B, T = objective.shape

    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', B * max_pairs_per_instance))
    max_pairs_per_instance = 1 if max_pairs_per_instance < 1 else max_pairs_per_instance

    # Use ranks (quantiles) rather than all pairwise comparisons.
    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # [B, T]

    # If we cannot form any non-self pairs, return empty.
    if T < 2:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rank_quantile_coverage', 'degenerate_T': int(T)})

    # Choose Q quantile anchors and pair each with a fixed set of worse quantiles.
    Q = int(extra.get('quantiles', 4))
    Q = 2 if Q < 2 else Q
    Q = T if Q > T else Q

    # Quantile ranks in [0, T-1], strictly increasing.
    qpos = torch.linspace(0, T - 1, steps=Q, device=objective.device)
    qpos = qpos.round().to(torch.long)
    qpos = torch.unique_consecutive(qpos)
    Qeff = int(qpos.numel())

    # Ensure we have at least two quantile points.
    if Qeff < 2:
        qpos = torch.tensor([0, T - 1], device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
        Qeff = 2

    anchors = order[:, qpos]  # [B, Qeff]

    # Build all (qi < qj) quantile pairs in one shot, then take a deterministic prefix.
    qi = torch.arange(Qeff, device=objective.device)
    qj = torch.arange(Qeff, device=objective.device)
    q_w_mask = (qi[:, None] < qj[None, :])

    w_q = qi[:, None].expand(Qeff, Qeff)[q_w_mask]  # [Pq]
    l_q = qj[None, :].expand(Qeff, Qeff)[q_w_mask]  # [Pq]
    Pq = int(w_q.numel())

    # Repeat quantile-pair template across batch.
    w_q_mat = w_q[None, :].expand(B, Pq)
    l_q_mat = l_q[None, :].expand(B, Pq)

    winner_mat = anchors.gather(1, w_q_mat)  # [B, Pq]
    loser_mat = anchors.gather(1, l_q_mat)   # [B, Pq]

    # Optional: suppress near-ties by requiring a minimum rank separation in quantile space.
    min_rank_gap = int(extra.get('min_rank_gap', 1))
    if min_rank_gap < 1:
        min_rank_gap = 1
    rank_gap_ok = (l_q_mat - w_q_mat) >= min_rank_gap

    # Also ensure objective gap is positive (strict) to avoid ties.
    win_obj = objective.gather(1, winner_mat)
    lose_obj = objective.gather(1, loser_mat)
    obj_ok = lose_obj > win_obj

    valid = rank_gap_ok & obj_ok & (winner_mat != loser_mat)

    # Deterministically cap per instance by taking the first K valid pairs in quantile order.
    k_per = max_pairs_per_instance
    rank_in_row = torch.cumsum(valid.to(torch.long), dim=1)
    take = valid & (rank_in_row <= k_per)

    # If an instance has zero valid pairs (e.g., all ties), force best-vs-worst.
    per_has = take.any(dim=1)
    if (~per_has).any():
        fallback_w = order[:, 0]
        fallback_l = order[:, -1]
        fb_ok = fallback_w != fallback_l
        take_fb = (~per_has) & fb_ok
        # Create a single-slot fallback matrices
        fb_w_mat = fallback_w[:, None]
        fb_l_mat = fallback_l[:, None]
        fb_valid = take_fb[:, None]

        # Concatenate fallback slot to the right; keep cap by prioritizing existing pairs.
        winner_mat = torch.cat([winner_mat, fb_w_mat], dim=1)
        loser_mat = torch.cat([loser_mat, fb_l_mat], dim=1)
        take = torch.cat([take, fb_valid], dim=1)

        # Re-apply cap after adding fallback.
        rank_in_row = torch.cumsum(take.to(torch.long), dim=1)
        take = take & (rank_in_row <= k_per)

    b_mat = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand_as(winner_mat)
    b_idx = b_mat[take]
    winner_idx = winner_mat[take]
    loser_idx = loser_mat[take]

    # Global cap deterministically (take a prefix); keeps full coverage because per-instance was capped first.
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        b_idx = b_idx[:max_pairs]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[:max_pairs]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[:max_pairs]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_quantile_coverage',
            'quantiles': int(Q),
            'min_rank_gap': int(min_rank_gap),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
        },
    )

    # lower objective is better; prefer i over j when objective[i] + gap_thr < objective[j]

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))

    # Weighting: w = clamp((gap - gap_thr) / weight_scale, 0, 1) in [0,1]

    # pairwise gap matrix: gap[b,i,j] = objective[b,j] - objective[b,i]

    valid = gap > gap_thr

    flat_gap = gap.view(B, -1)
    flat_valid = valid.view(B, -1)

    # Exclude invalid and diagonal by setting to -inf
    scores = torch.where(flat_valid, flat_gap, torch.full_like(flat_gap, float('-inf')))
    k_per = min(max_pairs_per_instance, T * T)
    top_scores, top_idx = torch.topk(scores, k=k_per, dim=1)
    keep = top_scores > float('-inf')

    # Decode (i,j) from flattened index
    winner_idx = (top_idx // T).masked_select(keep)
    loser_idx = (top_idx % T).masked_select(keep)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_per).masked_select(keep)

    sel_gap = top_scores.masked_select(keep)

    weight = torch.clamp((sel_gap - gap_thr) / denom, min=0.0, max=1.0)

    # Global cap by strongest gaps (carry weights along)
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        _, order = torch.topk(sel_gap, k=max_pairs, dim=0)
        b_idx = b_idx[order]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[order]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[order]
        weight = weight[order]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=weight,
        meta={
            'builder': 'gap_topk_pairs_weighted',
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'weight_scale': weight_scale,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance,

    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 1e-3))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs = max(1, max_pairs)

    k_worst = int(extra.get('k_worst', 2))
    k_worst = max(1, min(k_worst, max(1, N)))

    k_extra = int(extra.get('k_extra_per_instance', 2))
    k_extra = max(0, min(k_extra, 64))

    # 1) Anchor best-vs-worst (coverage)
    winner = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # [B]
    worst_vals, worst_idx = torch.topk(objective, k=k_worst, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)  # [B, k_worst]

    b1 = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_worst).reshape(-1)
    w1 = winner[:, None].expand(B, k_worst).reshape(-1)
    l1 = worst_idx.reshape(-1)

    # Filter accidental self-pairs (possible when N==1)
    ok1 = (w1 != l1)
    b1 = b1[ok1]
    w1 = w1[ok1]
    l1 = l1[ok1]

    # 2) Extra: pick strongest objective-gap pairs above threshold per instance (deterministic)
    # gap[b,i,j] = objective[b,j] - objective[b,i] (positive => i better than j)
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]  # [B, N, N]
    if N > 0:
        diag = torch.eye(N, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.bool)[None, :, :]
        valid = (gap > gap_thr) & (~diag)
    else:
        valid = gap > gap_thr

    flat_gap = gap.reshape(B, N * N)
    flat_valid = valid.reshape(B, N * N)
    scores = torch.where(flat_valid, flat_gap, torch.full_like(flat_gap, float('-inf')))

    k2 = min(k_extra, N * N)
    if k2 > 0:
        top_vals, top_idx = torch.topk(scores, k=k2, dim=1)
        keep2 = top_vals.isfinite()
        b2 = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k2)[keep2]
        flat2 = top_idx[keep2]
        w2 = (flat2 // N).to(dtype=torch.long)
        l2 = (flat2 % N).to(dtype=torch.long)
    else:
        b2 = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        w2 = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        l2 = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)

    # 3) Concatenate and deterministically downsample to max_pairs (prefer larger gaps)
    b_all = torch.cat([b1.to(dtype=torch.long), b2.to(dtype=torch.long)], dim=0)
    w_all = torch.cat([w1.to(dtype=torch.long), w2.to(dtype=torch.long)], dim=0)
    l_all = torch.cat([l1.to(dtype=torch.long), l2.to(dtype=torch.long)], dim=0)

    if b_all.numel() == 0:
        # Ultimate fallback: best-vs-worst single pair per instance (or empty if N==0)
        if N == 0:
            b_all = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            w_all = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            l_all = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        else:
            w = objective.argmin(dim=1)
            l = objective.argmax(dim=1)
            b_all = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
            w_all = w.to(dtype=torch.long)
            l_all = l.to(dtype=torch.long)
            ok = (w_all != l_all)
            b_all = b_all[ok]
            w_all = w_all[ok]
            l_all = l_all[ok]

    if b_all.numel() > max_pairs:
        # Score by realized gap; larger is better.
        ow = objective[b_all, w_all]
        ol = objective[b_all, l_all]
        pair_gap = (ol - ow)
        order = torch.topk(pair_gap, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_all = b_all[order]
        w_all = w_all[order]
        l_all = l_all[order]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_all, w_all, l_all),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'anchor_plus_topgaps_v1',
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'k_worst': k_worst,
            'k_extra_per_instance': k_extra,

                'frac_near': float(frac_near),

    if k_near < 0:

    if k_mid < 0:

    if k_tail < 0:

    # Near-best: ranks [0 .. k_near]
    # Mid: centered around median

    pairs_b = []
    pairs_w = []
    pairs_l = []
    pairs_score = []

    b = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)

    def _adjacent_segment(start_rank, seg_len):

        seg = _adjacent_segment(mid_start, k_mid)

    b_mat = torch.cat(pairs_b, dim=1)
    w_mat = torch.cat(pairs_w, dim=1)

    gap_val = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp_min(0.0)
    weight = gap_val / (gap_val + gap_scale)

        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=weight,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_stratified_mixedgap',
            'gap_threshold': float(gap_thr),
            'gap_scale': float(gap_scale),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),

    best = order[:, 0]  # [B]

    # Choose fixed rank positions deterministically.
    mid_start = max(1, N // 3)
    mid_end = max(mid_start, (2 * N) // 3)
    mid_pool = order[:, mid_start:mid_end]  # [B, M]
    tail_pool = order[:, max(1, N - max(1, min(N - 1, max(k_tail, 1) * 2))):]  # [B, Ttail]

    k_mid_eff = min(k_mid, mid_pool.shape[1])
    k_tail_eff = min(k_tail, tail_pool.shape[1])

    if k_mid_eff > 0:
        mid_idx = mid_pool[:, :k_mid_eff]
    else:
        mid_idx = objective.new_empty((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)

    if k_tail_eff > 0:
        tail_idx = tail_pool[:, -k_tail_eff:]
    else:
        tail_idx = objective.new_empty((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)

    # Adjacent comparisons along the sorted order (local ordering signal).
    # Pairs: order[r] preferred over order[r+1] for r in [0, k_adj_eff-1].
    k_adj_eff = min(k_adj, N - 1)
    if k_adj_eff > 0:
        adj_w = order[:, :k_adj_eff]
        adj_l = order[:, 1:1 + k_adj_eff]
    else:
        adj_w = objective.new_empty((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        adj_l = objective.new_empty((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)

    # Anchor best against mid and tail strata.
    tgt = torch.cat([mid_idx, tail_idx], dim=1)  # [B, K]
    if tgt.numel() > 0:
        anc_w = best[:, None].expand_as(tgt)
        anc_l = tgt
    else:
        anc_w = objective.new_empty((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)
        anc_l = objective.new_empty((B, 0), dtype=torch.long)

    # Combine all candidate pairs.
    w_all = torch.cat([anc_w, adj_w], dim=1)
    l_all = torch.cat([anc_l, adj_l], dim=1)

    b_all = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand_as(w_all)

    # Filter self-pairs and tiny gaps.
    ow = objective.gather(1, w_all)
    ol = objective.gather(1, l_all)
    gap = (ol - ow)
    ok = (w_all != l_all) & (gap > gap_thr)

    # Ensure at least one pair per instance: fall back to best-vs-worst if none pass threshold.
    any_ok = ok.any(dim=1)
    worst = order[:, -1]
    fb_w = best
    fb_l = worst
    fb_gap = objective[torch.arange(B, device=objective.device), fb_l] - objective[torch.arange(B, device=objective.device), fb_w]
    fb_ok = (fb_w != fb_l) & (fb_gap > 0)

    # Assemble per-instance capped selections using topk on realized gaps.
    # Assign -inf to invalid.
    ninf = torch.tensor(float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    gap_score = torch.where(ok, gap, ninf)

    k_per = min(max_pairs_per_instance, w_all.shape[1])
    if k_per > 0:
        top_vals, top_pos = torch.topk(gap_score, k=k_per, dim=1)
        keep = top_vals > ninf

        b_sel = b_all.gather(1, top_pos)[keep]
        w_sel = w_all.gather(1, top_pos)[keep]
        l_sel = l_all.gather(1, top_pos)[keep]
        s_sel = top_vals[keep]
    else:
        b_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        w_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        l_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        s_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    # Add fallbacks for instances with no valid pairs.
    need_fb = (~any_ok) & fb_ok
    if need_fb.any():
        b_fb = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[need_fb]
        w_fb = fb_w[need_fb].to(dtype=torch.long)
        l_fb = fb_l[need_fb].to(dtype=torch.long)
        s_fb = fb_gap[need_fb].to(dtype=objective.dtype)
        b_sel = torch.cat([b_sel, b_fb], dim=0)
        w_sel = torch.cat([w_sel, w_fb], dim=0)
        l_sel = torch.cat([l_sel, l_fb], dim=0)
        s_sel = torch.cat([s_sel, s_fb], dim=0)

    # Deterministic global cap by strongest realized gaps.
    if b_sel.numel() > max_pairs:
        order_g = torch.topk(s_sel, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_sel = b_sel[order_g]
        w_sel = w_sel[order_g]
        l_sel = l_sel[order_g]
        s_sel = s_sel[order_g]

    # Nonnegative bounded weights to emphasize clearer separations.
    gap_scale = float(extra.get('gap_scale', 0.5))
    g = s_sel.clamp_min(0.0)
    weight = g / (g + gap_scale)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_sel, w_sel, l_sel),
        weight=weight,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_stratified_cap_001',
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance,
            'k_mid': k_mid,
            'k_tail': k_tail,
            'k_adjacent': k_adj,
            'gap_scale': gap_scale,
        },
    )

ir.intuition: Shared strengths: objective-consistent, deterministic pairing; suppress near-ties via a gap notion; cap pairs per instance to control budget. Shared weaknesses (from gate feedback): insufficient coverage when filtering/top-k yields zero pairs for some instances, and joint/consistency issues when many correlated pairs come from a narrow region. This builder keeps determinism and near-tie suppression but changes the mechanism to rank-stratified, balanced pairing: every instance always emits up to K pairs by pairing near-best vs tail, mid vs tail, and near-best vs mid using rank strata with an optional objective-gap threshold, guaranteeing full instance coverage without scanning all O(T^2) pairs.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # lower objective is better
    B, T = objective.shape

    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs_per_instance = 1 if max_pairs_per_instance < 1 else max_pairs_per_instance
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', B * max_pairs_per_instance))

    if T < 2:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty),
            weight=None,
            meta={
                'builder': 'rank_strata_balanced',
                'degenerate_T': int(T),
                'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
                'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
            },
        )

    # Deterministic ranking per instance.
    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # [B, T]

    # Strata sizes (at least 1 each, and sum <= T).
    top_k = int(extra.get('top_k', max(1, T // 8)))
    mid_k = int(extra.get('mid_k', max(1, T // 4)))
    tail_k = int(extra.get('tail_k', max(1, T // 4)))

    top_k = 1 if top_k < 1 else top_k
    mid_k = 1 if mid_k < 1 else mid_k
    tail_k = 1 if tail_k < 1 else tail_k

    # Clamp to feasible sizes.
    top_k = T if top_k > T else top_k
    mid_k = (T - top_k) if mid_k > (T - top_k) else mid_k
    mid_k = 1 if mid_k < 1 else mid_k
    tail_k = (T - top_k - mid_k) if tail_k > (T - top_k - mid_k) else tail_k
    tail_k = 1 if tail_k < 1 else tail_k

    # Indices for strata.
    top = order[:, :top_k]  # [B, top_k]
    mid = order[:, top_k:top_k + mid_k]  # [B, mid_k]
    tail = order[:, T - tail_k:]  # [B, tail_k]

    # Build candidate pair grids (vectorized, no O(T^2)).
    # 1) top vs tail
    w_tt = top[:, :, None].expand(B, top_k, tail_k).reshape(B, top_k * tail_k)
    l_tt = tail[:, None, :].expand(B, top_k, tail_k).reshape(B, top_k * tail_k)

    # 2) mid vs tail
    w_mt = mid[:, :, None].expand(B, mid_k, tail_k).reshape(B, mid_k * tail_k)
    l_mt = tail[:, None, :].expand(B, mid_k, tail_k).reshape(B, mid_k * tail_k)

    # 3) top vs mid
    w_tm = top[:, :, None].expand(B, top_k, mid_k).reshape(B, top_k * mid_k)
    l_tm = mid[:, None, :].expand(B, top_k, mid_k).reshape(B, top_k * mid_k)

    winner_mat = torch.cat([w_tt, w_mt, w_tm], dim=1)
    loser_mat = torch.cat([l_tt, l_mt, l_tm], dim=1)

    # Validity: strict objective improvement and optional minimum objective gap.
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    win_obj = objective.gather(1, winner_mat)
    lose_obj = objective.gather(1, loser_mat)
    gap = lose_obj - win_obj

    valid = (winner_mat != loser_mat) & (gap > gap_thr)

    # Cap per instance by taking the first K valid pairs in the fixed (stratified) order.
    k_per = max_pairs_per_instance
    rank_in_row = torch.cumsum(valid.to(torch.long), dim=1)
    take = valid & (rank_in_row <= k_per)

    # Fallback to guarantee coverage: best vs worst (no gap threshold).
    per_has = take.any(dim=1)
    if (~per_has).any():
        fb_w = order[:, 0]
        fb_l = order[:, -1]
        fb_valid = (~per_has) & (fb_w != fb_l)
        winner_mat = torch.cat([winner_mat, fb_w[:, None]], dim=1)
        loser_mat = torch.cat([loser_mat, fb_l[:, None]], dim=1)
        take = torch.cat([take, fb_valid[:, None]], dim=1)
        rank_in_row = torch.cumsum(take.to(torch.long), dim=1)
        take = take & (rank_in_row <= k_per)

    b_mat = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand_as(winner_mat)
    b_idx = b_mat[take]
    winner_idx = winner_mat[take]
    loser_idx = loser_mat[take]

    # Global cap (prefix preserves per-instance priority and determinism).
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        b_idx = b_idx[:max_pairs]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[:max_pairs]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[:max_pairs]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_strata_balanced',
            'gap_threshold': float(gap_thr),
            'top_k': int(top_k),
            'mid_k': int(mid_k),
            'tail_k': int(tail_k),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
        },
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # lower objective is better
    B, T = objective.shape

    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs_per_instance = 1 if max_pairs_per_instance < 1 else max_pairs_per_instance
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', B * max_pairs_per_instance))

    # If we cannot form any non-self pairs, return empty.
    if T < 2:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rank_quantile_coverage_tuned', 'degenerate_T': int(T)})

    # Objective gap threshold to suppress near-ties (strict).
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 1e-4))

    # Use ranks (quantiles) rather than all pairwise comparisons.
    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # [B, T]

    # Choose Q quantile points; slightly higher default for better coverage/diversity.
    Q = int(extra.get('quantiles', 6))
    Q = 2 if Q < 2 else Q
    Q = T if Q > T else Q

    qpos = torch.linspace(0, T - 1, steps=Q, device=objective.device)
    qpos = qpos.round().to(torch.long)
    qpos = torch.unique_consecutive(qpos)
    Qeff = int(qpos.numel())
    if Qeff < 2:
        qpos = torch.tensor([0, T - 1], device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
        Qeff = 2

    anchors = order[:, qpos]  # [B, Qeff]

    # Build all (qi < qj) quantile pairs in one shot.
    qi = torch.arange(Qeff, device=objective.device)
    qj = torch.arange(Qeff, device=objective.device)
    q_w_mask = (qi[:, None] < qj[None, :])

    w_q = qi[:, None].expand(Qeff, Qeff)[q_w_mask]  # [Pq]
    l_q = qj[None, :].expand(Qeff, Qeff)[q_w_mask]  # [Pq]
    Pq = int(w_q.numel())

    w_q_mat = w_q[None, :].expand(B, Pq)
    l_q_mat = l_q[None, :].expand(B, Pq)

    winner_mat = anchors.gather(1, w_q_mat)  # [B, Pq]
    loser_mat = anchors.gather(1, l_q_mat)   # [B, Pq]

    # Minimum separation in quantile space.
    min_rank_gap = int(extra.get('min_rank_gap', 2))
    if min_rank_gap < 1:
        min_rank_gap = 1
    rank_gap_ok = (l_q_mat - w_q_mat) >= min_rank_gap

    win_obj = objective.gather(1, winner_mat)
    lose_obj = objective.gather(1, loser_mat)
    obj_ok = (lose_obj - win_obj) > gap_thr

    valid = rank_gap_ok & obj_ok & (winner_mat != loser_mat)

    # Deterministically cap per instance by taking the first K valid pairs in quantile order.
    k_per = max_pairs_per_instance
    rank_in_row = torch.cumsum(valid.to(torch.long), dim=1)
    take = valid & (rank_in_row <= k_per)

    # If an instance has zero valid pairs, fall back to best-vs-worst if it clears the gap.
    per_has = take.any(dim=1)
    if (~per_has).any():
        fallback_w = order[:, 0]
        fallback_l = order[:, -1]
        fb_win = objective.gather(1, fallback_w[:, None]).squeeze(1)
        fb_lose = objective.gather(1, fallback_l[:, None]).squeeze(1)
        fb_ok = (fallback_w != fallback_l) & ((fb_lose - fb_win) > gap_thr)
        take_fb = (~per_has) & fb_ok

        fb_w_mat = fallback_w[:, None]
        fb_l_mat = fallback_l[:, None]
        fb_valid = take_fb[:, None]

        winner_mat = torch.cat([winner_mat, fb_w_mat], dim=1)
        loser_mat = torch.cat([loser_mat, fb_l_mat], dim=1)
        take = torch.cat([take, fb_valid], dim=1)

        # Re-apply cap after adding fallback.
        rank_in_row = torch.cumsum(take.to(torch.long), dim=1)
        take = take & (rank_in_row <= k_per)

    b_mat = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand_as(winner_mat)
    b_idx = b_mat[take]
    winner_idx = winner_mat[take]
    loser_idx = loser_mat[take]

    # Global cap deterministically (prefix). Per-instance capping preserves coverage.
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        b_idx = b_idx[:max_pairs]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[:max_pairs]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[:max_pairs]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_quantile_coverage_tuned',
            'quantiles': int(Q),
            'min_rank_gap': int(min_rank_gap),
            'gap_threshold': float(gap_thr),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
        },
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, T], lower is better
    B, T = objective.shape

    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 1e-3))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs = 1 if max_pairs < 1 else max_pairs

    # Always try to create coverage pairs: 1 anchor per instance (best vs worst).
    # Then add quantile-cross pairs capped per instance.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs_per_instance = 1 if max_pairs_per_instance < 1 else max_pairs_per_instance

    if T < 2:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty),
            weight=None,
            meta={'builder': 'anchor_quantile_topgap_v1', 'degenerate_T': int(T)},
        )

    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # [B, T]
    b = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)

    # (A) Coverage anchor: best vs worst, always one per instance.
    w0 = order[:, 0]
    l0 = order[:, -1]
    ok0 = (w0 != l0)
    b0 = b[ok0]
    w0 = w0[ok0]
    l0 = l0[ok0]

    # (B) Quantile-cross extras: take top-a quantiles vs bottom-b quantiles (deterministic grid).
    # Novelty vs parents: quantile-cross rather than all-pairs/topk, but still objective-gap filtered.
    a = int(extra.get('top_anchors', 3))
    c = int(extra.get('bottom_targets', 3))
    a = 1 if a < 1 else a
    c = 1 if c < 1 else c
    a = T if a > T else a
    c = T if c > T else c

    winners_q = order[:, :a]          # [B, a]
    losers_q = order[:, T - c:]       # [B, c]

    # Build all (winner from top-a) x (loser from bottom-c) pairs without Python loops.
    wmat = winners_q[:, :, None].expand(B, a, c).reshape(B, a * c)  # [B, P]
    lmat = losers_q[:, None, :].expand(B, a, c).reshape(B, a * c)   # [B, P]

    win_obj = objective.gather(1, wmat)
    lose_obj = objective.gather(1, lmat)
    gap = (lose_obj - win_obj)

    valid = (wmat != lmat) & (gap > gap_thr)

    # Cap extras per instance (leave room for the anchor; anchor already provides coverage).
    k_extra = max_pairs_per_instance - 1
    if k_extra < 0:
        k_extra = 0

    if k_extra > 0:
        scores = torch.where(valid, gap, torch.full_like(gap, float('-inf')))
        k_take = k_extra if k_extra < (a * c) else (a * c)
        topv, topi = torch.topk(scores, k=k_take, dim=1)
        keep = topv.isfinite()

        b1 = b[:, None].expand(B, k_take)[keep]
        flat = topi[keep]
        w1 = wmat.gather(1, topi)[keep]
        l1 = lmat.gather(1, topi)[keep]

        # If an instance had no valid extras, optionally fall back to best vs second-worst.
        # This keeps coverage stable even under aggressive gap thresholds.
        per_has = keep.any(dim=1)
        if (~per_has).any():
            fb_w = order[:, 0]
            fb_l = order[:, -2]
            fb_ok = ((fb_w != fb_l) & (~per_has))
            bfb = b[fb_ok]
            wfb = fb_w[fb_ok]
            lfb = fb_l[fb_ok]

            b_all = torch.cat([b0, b1.to(dtype=torch.long), bfb.to(dtype=torch.long)], dim=0)
            w_all = torch.cat([w0, w1.to(dtype=torch.long), wfb.to(dtype=torch.long)], dim=0)
            l_all = torch.cat([l0, l1.to(dtype=torch.long), lfb.to(dtype=torch.long)], dim=0)
        else:
            b_all = torch.cat([b0, b1.to(dtype=torch.long)], dim=0)
            w_all = torch.cat([w0, w1.to(dtype=torch.long)], dim=0)
            l_all = torch.cat([l0, l1.to(dtype=torch.long)], dim=0)
    else:
        b_all = b0
        w_all = w0
        l_all = l0

    # Global cap: keep the strongest realized objective gaps.
    if b_all.numel() > max_pairs:
        ow = objective[b_all, w_all]
        ol = objective[b_all, l_all]
        pair_gap = (ol - ow)
        sel = torch.topk(pair_gap, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_all = b_all[sel]
        w_all = w_all[sel]
        l_all = l_all[sel]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_all.to(dtype=torch.long), w_all.to(dtype=torch.long), l_all.to(dtype=torch.long)),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'anchor_quantile_topgap_v1',
            'gap_threshold': float(gap_thr),
            'top_anchors': int(a),
            'bottom_targets': int(c),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
        },
    )

        b_idx = b_idx[order]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[order]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[order]

ir.intuition: All parents use deterministic, per-instance capped pairing with an objective-gap filter to avoid near-ties, but they can miss coverage (some instances yield zero valid pairs) and can over-focus on extreme top-gap pairs which increases joint-preference violations. This builder keeps deterministic coverage and gap-gating, but changes the mechanism to rank-triplet margins: for each instance, compare a few fixed rank anchors (best/median) against fixed opponents (median/tail) and also enforce a local adjacent-rank ordering signal, then select the strongest realized margins per instance and globally; if an instance still has no valid pair, fall back to best-vs-worst to guarantee 100% coverage.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, N], lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs = 1 if max_pairs < 1 else max_pairs
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs_per_instance = 1 if max_pairs_per_instance < 1 else max_pairs_per_instance

    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))

    if N < 2:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        empty_w = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty),
            weight=empty_w,
            meta={'builder': 'rank_triplet_margin_cap_001', 'degenerate_N': int(N)},
        )

    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # [B, N]
    b = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)

    # Fixed rank anchors/opponents (rank-based, not all-pairs): best/median vs median/tail.
    best = order[:, 0]
    mid_pos = (N - 1) // 2
    mid = order[:, mid_pos]
    tail = order[:, -1]

    # Candidate pairs (columns are different pair types):
    # 1) best > mid, 2) best > tail, 3) mid > tail
    w_fixed = torch.stack([best, best, mid], dim=1)  # [B, 3]
    l_fixed = torch.stack([mid, tail, tail], dim=1)  # [B, 3]

    # Add a small number of adjacent-rank comparisons for local ordering signal.
    k_adj = int(extra.get('k_adjacent', 4))
    k_adj = 0 if k_adj < 0 else k_adj
    k_adj_eff = k_adj if k_adj < (N - 1) else (N - 1)
    if k_adj_eff > 0:
        adj_w = order[:, :k_adj_eff]
        adj_l = order[:, 1:1 + k_adj_eff]
        w_all = torch.cat([w_fixed, adj_w], dim=1)
        l_all = torch.cat([l_fixed, adj_l], dim=1)
    else:
        w_all = w_fixed
        l_all = l_fixed

    # Compute realized objective margins and gate by threshold to reduce noisy near-ties.
    ow = objective.gather(1, w_all)
    ol = objective.gather(1, l_all)
    gap = ol - ow
    ok = (w_all != l_all) & (gap > gap_thr)

    # Per-instance deterministic cap: take largest margins.
    ninf = torch.tensor(float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    scores = torch.where(ok, gap, ninf)
    k_per = max_pairs_per_instance if max_pairs_per_instance < scores.shape[1] else int(scores.shape[1])
    topv, topp = torch.topk(scores, k=k_per, dim=1)
    keep = topv > ninf

    b_mat = b[:, None].expand(B, k_per)
    b_sel = b_mat[keep]
    w_sel = w_all.gather(1, topp)[keep]
    l_sel = l_all.gather(1, topp)[keep]
    s_sel = topv[keep]

    # Ensure full instance coverage: if an instance produced no valid pair, force best-vs-worst.
    per_has = keep.any(dim=1)
    fb_w = best
    fb_l = tail
    fb_gap = objective[b, fb_l] - objective[b, fb_w]
    fb_ok = (fb_w != fb_l) & (fb_gap > 0)
    need_fb = (~per_has) & fb_ok
    if need_fb.any():
        b_fb = b[need_fb]
        w_fb = fb_w[need_fb]
        l_fb = fb_l[need_fb]
        s_fb = fb_gap[need_fb]
        b_sel = torch.cat([b_sel, b_fb], dim=0)
        w_sel = torch.cat([w_sel, w_fb], dim=0)
        l_sel = torch.cat([l_sel, l_fb], dim=0)
        s_sel = torch.cat([s_sel, s_fb.to(dtype=objective.dtype)], dim=0)

    # Nonnegative bounded weights emphasize clearer margins without blowing up scale.
    gap_scale = float(extra.get('gap_scale', 0.5))
    g = s_sel.clamp_min(0.0)
    weight = g / (g + gap_scale)

    # Deterministic global cap by strongest realized margins.
    if b_sel.numel() > max_pairs:
        sel = torch.topk(s_sel, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_sel = b_sel[sel]
        w_sel = w_sel[sel]
        l_sel = l_sel[sel]
        weight = weight[sel]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_sel, w_sel, l_sel),
        weight=weight,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_triplet_margin_cap_001',
            'gap_threshold': float(gap_thr),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
            'k_adjacent': int(k_adj),
            'gap_scale': float(gap_scale),
        },
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, T], lower is better
    B, T = objective.shape

    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 8e-4))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs = 1 if max_pairs < 1 else max_pairs
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs_per_instance = 1 if max_pairs_per_instance < 1 else max_pairs_per_instance

    if T < 2:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        w0 = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=w0, meta={'builder': 'rank_ladder_balanced_001', 'degenerate_T': int(T)})

    # Rank order for each instance.
    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # [B, T]

    # Deterministic ladder distances in rank space (adjacent + larger hops), all vectorized.
    # Example (T large): distances [1,2,4,8] clipped to <= T-1.
    d_count = int(extra.get('ladder_steps', 4))
    d_count = 1 if d_count < 1 else d_count
    d_count = 10 if d_count > 10 else d_count

    d_raw = (2 ** torch.arange(d_count, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long))
    dist = d_raw.clamp_max(T - 1)
    dist = torch.unique_consecutive(dist)

    # Build all pairs (r, r+dist[k]) for all r and all dist in one shot.
    r = torch.arange(T, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)  # [T]
    rr = r[None, :, None].expand(1, T, dist.numel())               # [1,T,D]
    dd = dist[None, None, :].expand(1, T, dist.numel())            # [1,T,D]
    r2 = rr + dd                                                   # [1,T,D]
    valid_rank = r2 < T

    # Flatten rank-pairs.
    rr_f = rr.expand(B, T, dist.numel()).reshape(B, -1)            # [B,P]
    r2_f = r2.expand(B, T, dist.numel()).reshape(B, -1)            # [B,P]
    valid_rank_f = valid_rank.expand(B, T, dist.numel()).reshape(B, -1)

    w_idx = order.gather(1, rr_f.clamp_max(T - 1))
    l_idx = order.gather(1, r2_f.clamp_max(T - 1))

    # Objective-gap filter (suppresses near-ties / violations).
    ow = objective.gather(1, w_idx)
    ol = objective.gather(1, l_idx)
    gap = (ol - ow)

    ok = valid_rank_f & (w_idx != l_idx) & (gap > gap_thr)

    # Ensure coverage: if an instance has no valid ladder pairs, fall back to best-vs-worst.
    any_ok = ok.any(dim=1)
    best = order[:, 0]
    worst = order[:, -1]
    fb_gap = objective[torch.arange(B, device=objective.device), worst] - objective[torch.arange(B, device=objective.device), best]
    fb_ok = (best != worst) & (fb_gap > 0)
    need_fb = (~any_ok) & fb_ok

    # Per-instance cap via topk on realized gaps (no Python loops over pairs).
    ninf = torch.tensor(float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = torch.where(ok, gap, ninf)
    k_per = max_pairs_per_instance
    k_per = score.shape[1] if k_per > score.shape[1] else k_per

    topv, topp = torch.topk(score, k=k_per, dim=1)
    keep = topv > ninf

    b_mat = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_per)
    b_sel = b_mat[keep]
    w_sel = w_idx.gather(1, topp)[keep]
    l_sel = l_idx.gather(1, topp)[keep]
    s_sel = topv[keep]

    # Append fallbacks for uncovered instances.
    if need_fb.any():
        b_fb = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[need_fb]
        w_fb = best[need_fb].to(dtype=torch.long)
        l_fb = worst[need_fb].to(dtype=torch.long)
        s_fb = fb_gap[need_fb].to(dtype=objective.dtype)
        b_sel = torch.cat([b_sel, b_fb], dim=0)
        w_sel = torch.cat([w_sel, w_fb], dim=0)
        l_sel = torch.cat([l_sel, l_fb], dim=0)
        s_sel = torch.cat([s_sel, s_fb], dim=0)

    # Deterministic global cap: keep strongest realized gaps.
    if b_sel.numel() > max_pairs:
        idx = torch.topk(s_sel, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_sel = b_sel[idx]
        w_sel = w_sel[idx]
        l_sel = l_sel[idx]
        s_sel = s_sel[idx]

    # Nonnegative bounded weights emphasizing clearer separations while staying smooth.
    gap_scale = float(extra.get('gap_scale', 0.5))
    g = s_sel.clamp_min(0.0)
    weight = g / (g + gap_scale)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_sel, w_sel, l_sel),
        weight=weight,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_ladder_balanced_001',
            'gap_threshold': float(gap_thr),
            'ladder_steps': int(d_count),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
            'gap_scale': float(gap_scale),
        },
    )

    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 2.5e-4))

    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    # Reserve some per-instance pairs so every instance with any valid pair contributes.
    reserve_per_instance = int(extra.get('reserve_per_instance', 2))

    B, T = objective.shape

    # pairwise gap matrix: gap[b,i,j] = objective[b,j] - objective[b,i]
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]
    valid = gap > gap_thr

    flat_gap = gap.view(B, -1)
    flat_valid = valid.view(B, -1)

    # Exclude invalid (including diagonal) by setting to -inf
    scores = torch.where(flat_valid, flat_gap, torch.full_like(flat_gap, float('-inf')))

    # Per-instance top-k selection
    k_per = min(max_pairs_per_instance, T * T)
    top_scores, top_idx = torch.topk(scores, k=k_per, dim=1)
    keep = top_scores > float('-inf')

    # Decode (i,j) from flattened index
    winner_idx_all = (top_idx // T).masked_select(keep)
    loser_idx_all = (top_idx % T).masked_select(keep)
    b_idx_all = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_per).masked_select(keep)
    sel_scores_all = top_scores.masked_select(keep)

    k_res = int(min(max(reserve_per_instance, 0), k_per))
    if k_res > 0:
        keep_res = keep[:, :k_res]
        b_idx_res = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_res).masked_select(keep_res)
        winner_idx_res = (top_idx[:, :k_res] // T).masked_select(keep_res)
        loser_idx_res = (top_idx[:, :k_res] % T).masked_select(keep_res)
        sel_scores_res = top_scores[:, :k_res].masked_select(keep_res)

        winner_idx_res = winner_idx_all[:0]
        loser_idx_res = loser_idx_all[:0]
        sel_scores_res = sel_scores_all[:0]

    # Fill remaining budget with globally best-scoring remaining pairs
    budget_left = max_pairs - int(b_idx_res.numel())
    if budget_left <= 0:

        winner_idx = winner_idx_res[:max_pairs]
        loser_idx = loser_idx_res[:max_pairs]

            w_pool = winner_idx_all
            l_pool = loser_idx_all

            w_pool = w_pool[order]
            l_pool = l_pool[order]

        winner_idx = torch.cat([winner_idx_res, w_pool], dim=0)
        loser_idx = torch.cat([loser_idx_res, l_pool], dim=0)

    B, T = objective.shape

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs = 1 if max_pairs < 1 else max_pairs
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs_per_instance = 1 if max_pairs_per_instance < 1 else max_pairs_per_instance
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 1e-3))

    if T < 2:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        w0 = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=w0, meta={'builder': 'anchor_ladder_mix_001', 'degenerate_T': int(T)})

    b = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)  # [B,T]
    best = order[:, 0]
    worst = order[:, -1]

    # Always include best-vs-worst as a coverage guarantee (later gated by gap>0).
    bw_gap = objective[b, worst] - objective[b, best]
    bw_ok = (best != worst) & (bw_gap > 0)

    # Anchor extra: best against top-k worst losers (objective-based), gated by gap_thr.
    k_anchor = int(extra.get('k_anchor', 8))
    k_anchor = 0 if k_anchor < 0 else k_anchor
    k_anchor = (T - 1) if k_anchor > (T - 1) else k_anchor
    best_obj = objective[b, best]
    diffs = objective - best_obj[:, None]
    valid_anchor = diffs > gap_thr
    valid_anchor.scatter_(1, best[:, None], False)
    ninf = torch.tensor(float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    anchor_score = objective.masked_fill(~valid_anchor, ninf)
    if k_anchor > 0:
        a_topv, a_topi = torch.topk(anchor_score, k=k_anchor, dim=1)
        a_keep = a_topv > ninf
        a_b = b[:, None].expand(B, k_anchor)[a_keep]
        a_w = best[:, None].expand(B, k_anchor)[a_keep]
        a_l = a_topi[a_keep]
        a_s = (objective[a_b, a_l] - objective[a_b, a_w])
    else:
        a_b = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        a_w = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        a_l = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        a_s = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    ladder_steps = int(extra.get('ladder_steps', 3))
    ladder_steps = 0 if ladder_steps < 0 else ladder_steps
    ladder_steps = 8 if ladder_steps > 8 else ladder_steps
    if ladder_steps > 0:

        dist = d_raw.clamp_max(T - 1)
        dist = torch.unique_consecutive(dist)
        D = int(dist.numel())

        r = torch.arange(T, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
        rr = r[None, :, None].expand(1, T, D)
        dd = dist[None, None, :].expand(1, T, D)
        r2 = rr + dd
        valid_rank = r2 < T

        rr_f = rr.expand(B, T, D).reshape(B, -1)
        r2_f = r2.expand(B, T, D).reshape(B, -1)
        valid_rank_f = valid_rank.expand(B, T, D).reshape(B, -1)

        l_w = order.gather(1, rr_f.clamp_max(T - 1))
        l_l = order.gather(1, r2_f.clamp_max(T - 1))
        ow = objective.gather(1, l_w)
        ol = objective.gather(1, l_l)
        l_gap = (ol - ow)
        l_ok = valid_rank_f & (l_w != l_l) & (l_gap > gap_thr)

        if k_ladder > 0:

            l_b = b[:, None].expand(B, k_ladder)[l_keep]
            l_w_sel = l_w.gather(1, l_topp)[l_keep]
            l_l_sel = l_l.gather(1, l_topp)[l_keep]
            l_s_sel = l_topv[l_keep]
        else:
            l_b = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            l_w_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            l_l_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
            l_s_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
    else:
        l_b = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        l_w_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        l_l_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        l_s_sel = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)

    bw_b = b[bw_ok]
    bw_w = best[bw_ok]
    bw_l = worst[bw_ok]
    bw_s = bw_gap[bw_ok].to(dtype=objective.dtype)

    w_all = torch.cat([bw_w, a_w, l_w_sel], dim=0)
    l_all = torch.cat([bw_l, a_l, l_l_sel], dim=0)
    s_all = torch.cat([bw_s, a_s, l_s_sel], dim=0)

    if b_all.numel() == 0:
        b_all = b
        w_all = best
        l_all = worst
        s_all = (objective[b, worst] - objective[b, best]).clamp_min(0.0)

    # Per-instance cap: keep strongest gaps for each instance.
    # Build a [B, M] score matrix with -inf for non-matching entries.
    M = int(b_all.numel())
    b_mat = b_all[None, :].expand(B, M)
    match = b_mat == b[:, None]
    score_mat = torch.where(match, s_all[None, :].expand(B, M), ninf)

        w_sel = w_sel[gidx]
        l_sel = l_sel[gidx]
        s_sel = s_sel[gidx]

    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs_per_instance = 1 if max_pairs_per_instance < 1 else max_pairs_per_instance

    abs_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 8e-4))
    rel_thr = float(extra.get('rel_gap_threshold', 0.0))

    if T < 2:
        empty = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        w0 = objective.new_empty((0,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=w0, meta={'builder': 'rank_stratified_bandcap_001', 'degenerate_T': int(T)})

    # Per-instance adaptive threshold based on spread.
    obj_min = objective.min(dim=1, keepdim=True).values
    obj_max = objective.max(dim=1, keepdim=True).values
    spread = (obj_max - obj_min).clamp_min(0.0)
    thr = abs_thr + rel_thr * spread  # [B,1]

    order = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1)  # [B,T]
    r = torch.arange(T, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[None, :]  # [1,T]

    # Rank-band anchors: compare (anchor ranks) vs (anchor+dist ranks) for several dists.
    # Bands: near-best, middle, tail; this promotes coverage and avoids only extremes.
    a_frac = torch.tensor([0.1, 0.5, 0.9], device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    a = (a_frac * (T - 1)).round().to(dtype=torch.long)  # [3]

    d_count = int(extra.get('band_dists', 3))
    d_count = 1 if d_count < 1 else d_count
    d_count = 8 if d_count > 8 else d_count
    d_raw = (2 ** torch.arange(d_count, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long))
    dist = d_raw.clamp_max(T - 1)
    dist = torch.unique_consecutive(dist)

    # Optionally add a small fixed "hard" distance ~T/4 to create mid-hard comparisons.
    d_mid = torch.tensor([max(1, (T - 1) // 4)], device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
    dist = torch.cat([dist, d_mid], dim=0)
    dist = dist.clamp_max(T - 1)
    dist = torch.unique_consecutive(dist.sort().values)

    # Build candidate rank pairs in one shot: (a_k) and (a_k + dist_m).
    # Shapes: a[3], dist[D] -> pairs P = 3*D
    D = dist.numel()
    a_mat = a[:, None].expand(3, D)                 # [3,D]
    b_mat = (a[:, None] + dist[None, :])            # [3,D]
    valid_rank = b_mat < T

    b_flat = b_mat.reshape(-1)                      # [P]
    valid_flat = valid_rank.reshape(-1)             # [P]

    b_b = b_flat[None, :].expand(B, -1)             # [B,P]
    valid_b = valid_flat[None, :].expand(B, -1)     # [B,P]

    l_idx = order.gather(1, b_b.clamp_max(T - 1))

    ol = objective.gather(1, l_idx)

    any_ok = ok.any(dim=1)
    best = order[:, 0]
    worst = order[:, -1]

    need_fb = (~any_ok) & fb_ok

    ninf = torch.tensor(float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = torch.where(ok, gap, ninf)
    k_per = max_pairs_per_instance
    k_per = score.shape[1] if k_per > score.shape[1] else k_per

    topv, topp = torch.topk(score, k=k_per, dim=1)
    keep = topv > ninf

    b0 = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None].expand(B, k_per)
    b_sel = b0[keep]
    w_sel = w_idx.gather(1, topp)[keep]
    l_sel = l_idx.gather(1, topp)[keep]
    s_sel = topv[keep]

    if need_fb.any():

        w_fb = best[need_fb].to(dtype=torch.long)
        l_fb = worst[need_fb].to(dtype=torch.long)
        s_fb = fb_gap[need_fb].to(dtype=objective.dtype)
        b_sel = torch.cat([b_sel, b_fb], dim=0)
        w_sel = torch.cat([w_sel, w_fb], dim=0)
        l_sel = torch.cat([l_sel, l_fb], dim=0)
        s_sel = torch.cat([s_sel, s_fb], dim=0)

    # Global cap across batch: strongest realized gaps.
    if b_sel.numel() > max_pairs:
        idx = torch.topk(s_sel, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_sel = b_sel[idx]
        w_sel = w_sel[idx]
        l_sel = l_sel[idx]
        s_sel = s_sel[idx]

    # Nonnegative weights: emphasize clearer separations but avoid overemphasizing extremes.
    # Use rank distance to slightly downweight very easy (large rank-distance) pairs.
    ranks = torch.empty_like(order)
    ranks.scatter_(1, order, torch.arange(T, device=objective.device)[None, :].expand(B, T))

    rl = ranks[b_sel, l_sel]

    w_gap = g / (g + gap_scale)

        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_sel, w_sel, l_sel),
        weight=weight,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_stratified_bandcap_001',
            'gap_threshold': float(abs_thr),
            'rel_gap_threshold': float(rel_thr),
            'band_dists': int(d_count),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),

        w_all = w_fixed
        l_all = l_fixed

    ow = objective.gather(1, w_all)
    ol = objective.gather(1, l_all)
    gap = (ol - ow)

    ok = (w_all != l_all) & (gap > gap_thr)

    # Per-instance top-k by realized margin (vectorized).
    ninf = torch.tensor(float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = torch.where(ok, gap, ninf)
    k_per = max_pairs_per_instance
    k_per = score.shape[1] if k_per > score.shape[1] else k_per

    topv, topp = torch.topk(score, k=k_per, dim=1)
    keep = topv > ninf

    b_mat = b[:, None].expand(B, k_per)
    b_sel = b_mat[keep]
    w_sel = w_all.gather(1, topp)[keep]
    l_sel = l_all.gather(1, topp)[keep]
    s_sel = topv[keep]

    # Coverage fallback: best-vs-worst if an instance has no valid selected pairs.
    per_has = keep.any(dim=1)
    fb_gap = objective[b, tail] - objective[b, best]
    fb_ok = (best != tail) & (fb_gap > 0)
    need_fb = (~per_has) & fb_ok
    if need_fb.any():
        b_fb = b[need_fb]
        w_fb = best[need_fb]
        l_fb = tail[need_fb]
        s_fb = fb_gap[need_fb].to(dtype=objective.dtype)
        b_sel = torch.cat([b_sel, b_fb], dim=0)
        w_sel = torch.cat([w_sel, w_fb], dim=0)
        l_sel = torch.cat([l_sel, l_fb], dim=0)
        s_sel = torch.cat([s_sel, s_fb], dim=0)

    # Smooth bounded nonnegative weights from margins.
    g = s_sel.clamp_min(0.0)
    denom = g + (gap_scale if gap_scale > 1e-12 else 1e-12)
    weight = g / denom

    # Deterministic global cap: keep strongest realized margins.
    if b_sel.numel() > max_pairs:
        idx = torch.topk(s_sel, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_sel = b_sel[idx]
        w_sel = w_sel[idx]
        l_sel = l_sel[idx]
        weight = weight[idx]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_sel, w_sel, l_sel),
        weight=weight,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_strata_ring_001',
            'gap_threshold': float(gap_thr),
            'gap_scale': float(gap_scale),
            'k_adjacent': int(k_adj),
            'near_best_rank': int(nb_pos),
            'near_tail_rank_from_end': int(nt_pos_from_end),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(max_pairs_per_instance),
        },
    )
